comparison.objective: Pull, wipe, reseat, reread, report, and finally reseat an engine dipstick.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequenced extraction/insertion, wiping contact, visual-state reporting, and contamination-safe handling.
comparison.success_condition: Valid wipe–reseat–read sequence, correct level report, dipstick reseated, rag released.
comparison.reason: Tests procedural state preparation and measurement rather than bimanual impact fracture and loose-fragment containment.
